Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reliable held-action scheduling, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, a bounded held-action scheduler, reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds event-owned reactive counter-CC reservations: the exact actor, action, and eligible held-key generation are frozen when an urgent startup, enemy Purify, or enemy Guard is observed. Validated Resilience/Guard RemainingTime is only a non-extending wake-up hint; live status absence remains mandatory. The first absent frame at the expected Resilience end is immediate, early Guard cancellation remains immediate, and release, text-input poisoning, ambiguity, or identity drift cannot substitute another key or target. NIN now joins reactive counter-CC with metadata-verified Forked Raiju and Fleeting Raiju resolved through the exact PvP combo carrier at native 20-yalm range, plus exact Stun landing confirmation. Schema 30 and all existing opt-ins are preserved.
